gloss: to get excited; to be worked up; to be on edge

definitions.gloss: to get excited; to be worked up; to be on edge
definitions.explanation: Of emotions or nerves, to become heightened or aroused, often in a way that is hard to calm. Also written {昂|たか}ぶる.

examples.japanese: {気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高|たか}ぶる。
examples.english: To feel excited and worked up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高|たか}ぶって⟦{眠|ねむ}れない→眠れる：15166_nemureru⟧。
examples.english: My nerves are on edge and I can't sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高|たか}ぶって⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}かなかった→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: With an important presentation ahead, I was worked up and couldn't settle down.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive godan verb. X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高|たか}ぶる.

Describes emotions or nerves becoming heightened, often excitement or agitation. Frequently in the て-form ({高|たか}ぶって).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高|たか}ぶる: to feel worked up
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高|たか}ぶる: to be on edge; nerves heightened
- ⟦{感情|かんじょう}→感情：00171_kanjou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{高|たか}ぶる: emotions run high

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{興奮|こうふん}する→興奮する：25351_koufunsuru⟧: to get excited — more general and neutral
- ⟦{高揚|こうよう}→高揚：14658_kouyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be elated, uplifted — positive, elevated mood

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {高|たか}ぶっていませんでした
